messages:
paige: quick alignment thread  we need a single canonical changelog + docs permalink for the release post. can eng confirm final rollout window?
omar: planning canary 2026-07-20 11:00 UTC, full rollout 11:25 UTC for hosted. no infra conflicts.
lei: webinar at 12:00 UTC, landing page live at 11:40. marketing needs docs link by 11:20 to lock slides/CTAs.
paige: copy. paste the short release note we should use (one para + bullets). keeping it short helps the blog header.
omar: use the exact phrasing below for the announcement header:
```
RWD-Infer v2.7.0 (2026-07-20)
- Context-aware request routing to reduce cross-tenant interference
- New low-latency kernels for A10x that reduce per-token CPU overhead
- Deterministic tokenization option to improve eval consistency
- Stability fixes for streaming and checkpoint resumption
```
paige: thanks. marketing will use that verbatim. leap question: what's our consumer-friendly rollback line? want to show safety without jargon.
omar: publish: "If regressions occur, we automatically cut traffic back to rwd-infer-2.6.5 within minutes and re-run smoke checks." ops will provide exact probe cadence.
deploy-bot: Canary channel created: #deploy-1828007777-canary  will post hooks and healthcheck summaries.
lei: docs preview up at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/preview/2-7-0. ashley will publish final permalink at 11:15 UTC.
paige: inbound lead routing: registrants should be tagged release-summer20 and routed to SDR-E. sdr-integrations, can you confirm webhook mapping?
sdr-integrations: yes  webhook fields: campaign=summer-release, source=webinar-cta, tag=release-summer20. assigning to SDR-E. posting mapping to #integrations now.
paige: marketing benchmark blurb: "up to 30% throughput improvement on mixed short/long workloads." eng want a qualifier?
omar: prefer: "up to 30% throughput improvement on our mixed short/long sequence benchmark." keep the qualifier.
paige: ok we'll use that phrasing. final mini-checklist:
- omar: confirm deploy window (done)
- ashley/docs-bot: publish final permalink (pending)
- sdr-integrations: webhook mapping (done)
- deploy-bot/ops: run canary probes at t+0 and t+3m (pending)
- paige: post announcement T-10m and webinar CTA T-5m

omar: infra will post a T-30 note to the canary channel and a T-5 bump. leaning green from infra.
paige: scheduling 10:30 UTC preflight call for last checks. if anything changes ping here. thanks all :rocket:
